0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 5-2 and 3-0 at home, host the Cleveland Cavaliers, who are 4-3 and coming off a loss, for the Thunder's eighth game of the 2026-27 season. The Thunder, who are on a one-game winning streak and sit 2nd in the Northwest, are missing Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber, while the Cavaliers, who sit 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, are without Jaylon Tyson and Peyton Watson. Oklahoma City leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 117-112 win in Cleveland on November 2, and it also won both meetings in the 2025-26 season 2-0.
